This feature uses your front camera to capture a photo when someone enters the wrong PIN.

Photos are encrypted and stored only on your device. You can review them in Intruder Logs.

Camera permission is required to enable this feature.

VaultCalc can store the approximate location of unauthorized access attempts.

This uses your last known location only — no continuous tracking or background access.

Location permission is required to enable this.

uninstall_protection.tip2_body: To avoid hidden files being cleared by some cleaner apps, please exclude VaultCalc from the cleanup of these apps.
uninstall_protection.tip3_body: If you plan to uninstall, export all vault files to your gallery first using the "Export to Gallery" option.
uninstall_protection.disable_body: This will allow the app to be uninstalled. Your hidden files will be lost forever if the app is removed.
uninstall_protection.enable_error: Failed to request device admin activation.
